xrpl_amendment.name: fixCleanup3_4_0
technical_scope: PaymentBurn-only delegated payments cannot cross zero into a mint unless the delegate also has PaymentMint.
Vault rounding/asset-delivery, loan due-date/default, AMM, permissioned DEX, trust-line, NFT, MPT, escrow, sponsorship, signing and permission-delegation fixes.

lending_protocol.limitation: Nov 2 CoinDesk report citing XRPL Dashboard; refresh vote counts from ledger. The cleanup amendment does not activate separate lending/vault amendments.

observations.claim: Kodexius reported USD 843.90M XRP perpetual OI across seven contracts at 03:54 UTC, USD 1.51B 24-hour volume and +0.0099% funding per eight-hour equivalent.
limitations: Provider-specific universe.
Hyperliquid's native funding interval is one hour.
OI/funding alone do not establish price direction.

observations.claim: Same provider OI changed from USD 876.57M at 2026-11-03 17:54 UTC to USD 843.90M at 2026-11-04 03:54 UTC (-3.727%); rolling 24h volume changed from USD 1.35B to USD 1.51B (11.852%).
limitations: Both captures list seven contracts but exact membership continuity is unverified.
Rolling 24h windows overlap; not an incremental ten-hour flow.
Do not label as confirmed deleveraging or capital exit.

observations.claim: Binance represented 55.0% of the provider's reported XRP perpetual OI; Bybit 17.9%, OKX 12.0%, Hyperliquid 11.8% and HTX 3.3%.
limitations: Provider universe only; does not reveal global market or beneficial-owner concentration.

observations.claim: XRPLWin showed fixCleanup3_4_0 at 33/35 validators (94.29%) above the 29-vote threshold, with earliest activation 2026-11-04 14:46:22 UTC if support holds.
limitations: Pre-activation snapshot; not proof of later activation.
Live vote count is from one explorer vantage.

observations.claim: Official XRPL docs warn against delegating PaymentBurn until fixCleanup3_4_0 is enabled because a burn-only delegate can otherwise mint issued fungible tokens in certain circumstances; the amendment rejects a PaymentBurn-only payment crossing zero into a mint.
limitations: Issued trust-line tokens/MPTs, not native XRP issuance.
No evidence that Circle, Ripple or a named issuer delegated this permission or suffered exploitation.

competing_hypotheses.claim: fixCleanup3_4_0 may reduce issuer/delegate operational risk for issued XRPL assets without creating direct incremental XRP demand.
disconfirming_or_missing: No issuer-specific PaymentBurn deployment or post-activation data identified.
No measured change in stablecoin issuance, XRP bridge routing or XRP purchases.
competing_hypotheses.test: After activation, monitor issuer/delegate permissions, stablecoin issuance/redemption and XRP bridge legs separately.

competing_hypotheses.claim: The cleanup amendment must not be interpreted as activation of native XRPL lending or collateral markets.
disconfirming_or_missing: Fresh ledger vote counts for LendingProtocol and SingleAssetVault are still needed.
competing_hypotheses.test: Read both amendment vote records and activation flags directly from validated ledger state.

competing_hypotheses.claim: The same-provider OI decline with higher rolling volume is consistent with turnover or partial deleveraging but does not identify direction or net capital flow.
disconfirming_or_missing: Contract continuity, signed aggressor flow, liquidations and exchange-native raw OI history are missing.
competing_hypotheses.test: Reconstruct per-instrument OI, funding, basis, liquidations and signed trade flow at synchronized timestamps.

competing_hypotheses.claim: Binance's 55% share is concentration within Kodexius's current XRP perpetual universe, not necessarily all venues or beneficial owners.
disconfirming_or_missing: OTC, CME/institutional products, cross-margin and missing venues may change the denominator.
competing_hypotheses.test: Build an exchange-native instrument-normalized global venue panel.

competing_hypotheses.claim: Circle's Q3 disclosures may update USDC distribution and reserve economics but do not automatically imply XRPL or XRP demand.
disconfirming_or_missing: Results and XRPL-specific volumes unavailable at cutoff.
competing_hypotheses.test: Extract circulation, reserve income, distribution costs, CPN activity, Arc adoption and chain-specific metrics after webcast.

data_quality.no_averaging_policy: Do not average provider OI, funding, ETF or spot figures unless instrument/fund universe, units, timestamps, methodology and coverage match.
data_quality.feature_eligibility: New observations are not model-eligible until raw timestamps, source lineage and historical continuity are validated.
data_quality.clock_policy: Capture time, provider-as-of time, ledger index, publication time and event time remain distinct.
data_quality.source_independence: XRPLWin and CoinDesk are not independent live-validator feeds; official XRPL docs are primary for protocol semantics.

predictions.reason: Market data are provider-scoped and incomplete; amendment is pre-activation at cutoff; no calibrated out-of-sample predictive edge is established.
